dct_description_sm: Ukraine administrative level 0-4 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 05. This dataset is structured into 4 levels: - Admin 1: 27 Oblast (Region) - Admin 2: 139 Raion (District) - Admin 3: 1769 Hromada (Community) - Admin 4: 29706 Settlement, partial coverage Note: This dataset is structured into 4 levels: - Admin 1: 27 oblast (region) with three exceptions - Admin 2: 139 raion (district) with three exceptions - Admin 3: 1769 hromada (community) with three exceptions - Admin 4: 29706 populated place (city, settlement or village), partial coverage Dates associated with this dataset: - 18 December 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 01 September 2025: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 01 September 2025: last edit to the dataset before publishing Contributed by [OCHA Ukraine](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-ukraine). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
